title: Freddie on mandolin and accordion; Manuel Manetta
summary: Freddie played a little mandolin and the squeeze-box accordion but not in bands; Manuel Manetta is mentioned as a friend.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: He gave up the violin. He gave up the violin. When did he play on the mandolin? He said he was the first.

Then he played on the mandolin a little bit, but he wasn't playing with no band with the mandolin. But he could play. And he also was playing card then. I guess you know something about the card, Mr. Roussel. Sure. That card with that pull out and push in. The squeeze box. And then Manuel Manetta still is the first.
Manuel Manetta, that is his best friend.

And that is, he's from over the river. Yes. We know him. He is to play with Freddie. He is to play a violin with Freddie. And so you see, after he started playing the card then, well, he picked the line to it, but he dropped it all. And I had the cornet. He had it here, but I didn't, it then got so old, so I had to do way with it. Because it's the same as my sister, his family. She told it over to me about three weeks ago. And she's been having it ever since he stopped playing it, keeping it for a souvenir. Yes. You say he had a little cornet or?
